abstract: This paper analyzes the characteristics of the satellite communication system as well as the satellite communication channel and introduces the basic principles and outstanding advantages of convolutional code and MSK modulation.The combined implementation of properly chosen convolutional code and MSK modulation is a feasible scheme for the satellite communication with existing power limitation and all kinds of potential fading and noise.BER performance of convolutional code and MSK is simulated with Matlab/Simulink.The conclusions based on the simulation’s results provide references to the design of the satellite communication system.

articleTitle: Design and fabrication of a folding-and-rolling reflectarray antenna
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: Presents a new architecture of the reflectarray antenna, it is useful to reduce the weight and the volume of antenna when it is un-deployed. A detailed method of computing the cable system was introduced. Found that the axial force on the aluminum laminate boom is relatively small when the spans of the reflector boundary is odd. The most fundamental structural component of this antenna is the spring tape reinforced aluminum laminate inflatable boom. The finite element solution is closely approximate to the experiment results, when accomplishing the nonlinear buckling analysis of the aluminum laminate boom with initial imperfection of 5%. At the end, this new type of folding-and-rolling reflectarray antenna was made; the surface precision of this antenna was measured. The result shows that this kind of new type antenna is suitable for application.

articleTitle: SSOR preconditioned flexible GMRES method for MLFMM analysis of EM scattering problems
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: To efficiently solve large dense complex linear system arising from electric field integral equations (EFIE) formulation of electromagnetic scattering problems, the multilevel fast multipole method (MLFMM) is used to accelerate the matrix-vector product operations. The flexible generalized minimum residual method (FGMRES) is combined with the symmetric successive over-relaxation (SSOR) preconditioner based on the near-part matrix of the EFIE in the inner iteration of FGMRES to speed up the convergence rate of iterative methods. Numerical experiments with a few electromagnetic scattering problems for open structures are given to demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Simulation of PIN diode under electromagnetic pulse based on decision tree
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: The Electromagnetic pulse probably disturbs the normal operation of the PIN diode temporarily, or even damages the PIN diode permanently. Unlike just studying a certain aspect on the impact of the PIN diode in the other papers, the approach of decision trees is adopted to reveal the relationship between the extent of the PIN diode damage and the parameters (the rise time, width, and voltage) of electromagnetic pulse in an all-round manner. Besides, using decision tree to classify the degree of the PIN diode damage can save simulation time.

articleTitle: Design and optimization of liner phased array antennas with different distance based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: Compared to the array antennas with the same distance, those with different distances can improve the directivity and avoid occurrence of high minor-lobes. In this paper, GA is used to optimize the minor-lobes. During the progress, the minor-lobes level is defined as the fitness function. The first null direction is estimated properly so that the modified factor is used to avoid the complication of solving the non-linear function and the results of optimization variables are gained. The performance of GA is analyzed by simulation and the results show that the minor-lobes level of the array after optimized by GA is much lower and the antenna will work well over wide band.

articleTitle: Recent extensions in FEKO suite 5.4
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: Many new features have been included in the latest release of the electromagnetic simulation package FEKO suite 5.4 from July 2008. This paper aims at giving an overview of the major new features added to the computational kernel, which are: Modelling of periodic boundary conditions for 1-D and 2-D periodic structures, the inclusion of waveguide port excitations within the MoM/PO hybrid method, the parallelisation of the MoM/FEM hybrid method for distributed memory systems, and also the modelling of complicated cable harnesses by a new interface to the cable modelling code CRIPTE.

articleTitle: A memory-efficient formulation of the unconditionally stable WLP-BOR-FDTD method
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: To reduce memory requirement, the divergence theorem is introduced into the WLP-BOR-FDTD method. By substituting the Maxwell’s divergence equation for one of the curl equations, a substantial saving in computational memory is achieved. Numerical results are presented to verify the accuracy and the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Transmission properties of composite metamaterials in free space
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: We present free-space microwave measurements on composite metamaterials(CMMs) consisting of split ring resonators(SRRs) and wires on alternating boards, also known as left-handed material(LHM). Our experiments are based on a type of CMMs with unique configurations and the transmission measurements performed in free space exhibit a pass band extending from 10.5 to 13.5GH. The widely belief of the pass band is that the stop bands of the SRRs alone and the wires alone constitute a clear demonstration of left-handed (LH) behaviour. The LH behaviour only take place in the medium with simultaneously negative permittivity ε, and permeability μ, also called double negative materials.

articleTitle: The multi-layer fuzzy comprehensive judgment model for ISAR jamming effectiveness evaluation
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: Aimed at the disadvantages of traditional jamming effectiveness evaluation methods on ISAR, the multi-layer fuzzy comprehensive judgment approach was proposed and a general evaluation model was founded and applied with the jamming effectiveness evaluation index system.

articleTitle: U-band wideband receiver front-end
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: A 40-60 GHz wideband receiver front-end, consisting of a two-stage low noise amplifier (LNA) and a downconverter, is presented. The downconverter comprises a subharmonic mixer with a pair of anti-parallel diodes in asymmetric bilateral finline, and a local oscillator (LO) doubler-amplifier chain to provide the necessary LO power to the subharmonic mixer. Thus the U-band front-end operates with a LO frequency range of 10-15 GHz. The circuits are fabricated on 254 mum thick Rogers Duroid 5880 substrate in hybrid integrated circuit technology. Measurement results show the gain of LNA is around 24 dB, the conversion loss of the downconverter is in the range of 8-15 dB, and the front-end has a conversion gain greater than 6 dB over the range of 40-60 GHz.

articleTitle: Design and performance of CPW and CPW bandpass filter on SOI substrate
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: SOI technology gets more and more interests in RF ICs for its low loss, low crosstalk and other excellent electromagnetic properties. Well-behaved passive devices on SOI substrate will contribute a lot to the entire performance of RF ICs. In this paper, the influence of SOI parameters on transmission characteristics of coplanar waveguide (CPW) is researched by HFSS simulation. Based on the fine performance of a 50 Omega CPW fabricated on an available SOI substrate, a dual-termination coupled Ka band bandpass filter (BPF) has been designed and fabricated. It shows -4.23 dB insertion loss at peak transmission of about 32 GHz. The CPW and BPF realized on SOI gain close characteristics respectively to the same structure on high resistivity (rho ges1000 Omegamiddotcm) silicon substrate. SOI shows great potential to be the substrate of RF IC.

articleTitle: Research of electromagnetic environment inside metal housing based on LEMP
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: In this paper, a double exponential model of lightning electromagnetic pulse (LEMP) is simulated and the electromagnetic environment inside metal housing based on LEMP model is analyzed. Simulation results show that the electromagnetic environment inside metal housing can be interfered by LEMP strongly. The methods which contain both time domain and frequency domain have certain guidance in analyzing and calculating electromagnetic environment effect inside cabin such as airplane and missile and so on.

articleTitle: Near range MMW synthetic aperture radiometer 3D passive imaging
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: Millimeter wave synthetic aperture radiometer (MMW-SAR) technology can use phase information of electromagnetic wave radiating from target, and will be real-time imaging with less receiver elements. However MMW-SAR is limited to 2D imaging due to passive regime nowadays, lack of range information of target, which is very unfavorable for target detection and identification, thus this paper presents novel principle and algorithm for MMW-SAR 3D passive imaging under near range conditions. In near range, it is spherical wave radiation and wave front curvature of spherical wave is inversely proportional to propagation distance, synthetic aperture technology can get the curvature of the wave front. Thus there is quadratic phase factor in imaging formula primarily. Regarding the factor as LFM, the 3D imaging algorithm calculates the slope of LFM so as to get wave front curvature, then calculated range distribution. MMW-SAR 3D passive imaging can get both range distribution and brightness temperature distribution, which could effectively overcome fuzzy problem caused by defocus.

articleTitle: RCS reduction of Sierpinski gasket based metallo-dielectric structure
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: The scattering behaviour of Sierpinski gasket based metallo-dielectric structure loaded over metallic targets is reported. RCS reduction is obtained for the structure with frequency about 9-11GHz. Furthermore, we have presented a fitted linear equation to describe the relationship between reduction peak frequency vs permittivity. This may has application in stealth of aircrafts or ships and the design of Frequency Selective Surfaces.

articleTitle: Classification of atrial enlargement using neural networks
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: The aim of this study was to classify using a neural network LAE into mildly, moderately, and severely abnormal from a subjectpsilas P-wave. Cardiological features, wavelet features, and a combination of both were used to train the neural networks. It was found features derived from the wavelet energy spectrum performed better than the cardiological features on the test cases.

articleTitle: Wideband omnidirectional printed dipole array antenna
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: In this paper a wideband omnidirectional printed dipole array antenna with high gain is proposed by cascading the double side printed twin dipoles. The measured relative bandwidth for VSWR≪1.5 or S11≪−14dB reaches 10% (3893MHz∼4314MHz), and the measured gain is in a range of 7.71∼9.31dB, with a variation of 1.6dB.

articleTitle: A low profile antenna with shaped beams for indoor applications of WLAN systems
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: A novel low profile antenna composed of a shorted conical monopole, a top-loaded circular patch and a probe feed is presented. The antenna can operate in two different modes: the monopole antenna mode and the microstrip antenna mode, which leads to down-tilt radiation patterns when the antenna is mounted on a wall. An antenna prototype with dimension of 5.5 mm in height for WLAN operation in the 2.4-GHz band is demonstrated. Simulated and measured results show that the antenna has an impedance bandwidth of 560 MHz (2.17-2.73 GHz) and shaped-beam radiation patterns.

articleTitle: A small size broadband antenna used in VHF/UHF band
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: The planar monopole antenna is shown to provide extremely wideband impedance characteristics. This letter proposed a novel small size planar monopole antenna with vertical polarization and omni-directional features, operating from 110 MHz to 430 MHz. By introducing lump elements loading and two parasitic elements, broadband impedance is achieved. The electrically length of this antenna is only 0.11 lambda<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">min</sub>.

articleTitle: Electric field distribution inside wind turbine towers struck by lightning
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: A numerical method is presented in this paper to determine the transient electric field inside wind turbine towers struck by lightning. The tower is modelled by a coupled RLC network and the lightning transient responses of the network are calculated by solving its equivalent calculation circuit. The formula of transient electric field is derived from Maxwell’s equations based on the obtained branch currents. To confirm the validity of the proposed method, the computed results are compared with the simulation ones.

articleTitle: The nonlinearity character of avalanche diode driven by external RF signals and its application to W band microstrip integrated high order multiplier
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: The analysis of nonlinearity character of avalanche diode driven by external RF signals are presented. The modulation effect of RF signals to avalanche diode give rise to the generation of high order harmonic currents. Then a microsrtip integrated high order multiplier based on avalanche diode is designed, fabricated and measured. Effective output power of 2.8mW and the phase noise of 90 dBc at 10KHz offset have been obtained at output frequency of 96GHz.

articleTitle: 3D antenna for UHF RFID tags with near omni-direction
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: An improved design of 3D antenna for passive UHF RFID tags is presented. Tags using the proposed near omni directional antennas are situated in three orthogonal planes. Due to the combined magnitude of the electric field components for two orthogonal polarizations of the designed 3D antenna, the passive tag is invariant to its orientation. The shorted load is introduced to fix the situation of the two arms of the antenna. Through the adjustment of the height of the bifurcation point from the end of the two arms, the fine match of given ASIC and the designed antenna is acquired. The new type is similar to the carrier tape and can be made easily.

articleTitle: Coplanar waveguide structure of the differential connector impedance control
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: In high-speed transmission circuits, signal integrity is an inevitable problem, a major factor caused PCB board signal integrity problems is impedance mismatch. This paper based on the theory of transmission lines, according to the coplanar waveguide (CPW) structure, designed a high-speed differential connector which was separated by air. And use 2D simulation software to analyse the differential pairspsila geometry and the relationship of frequency and differential impedance. Through the parameters optimization, and get a good cross-section structure. This structure design of the connector has the advantages of small size, light weight and good impedance matching.

articleTitle: Pointing control of the antenna based on the accurate geometric model
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: The accurate pointing of the antenna is essential to radar system. The antenna pointing control system is put forward to realize the accurate and realtime control. Several coordinates systems are defined to describe the accurate geometric model about the antenna and the target. The azimuth angle and elevation angle to control the antenna are calculated by coordinate conversion. This system is simple and economical. It is proved satisfied in the practice application.

articleTitle: High frequency signal transfer characteristic of a 40-pin FPC connector
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: In this paper, we propose an equivalent electrical circuit model of a 40-pin board-to-FPC (flexible printed cable) connector for high frequency signal transfer characteristics. We fabricated an interface board to be fitted in FPC connector (0.5 mm pitch), which enables probing to measure signal transfer characteristics of 40-pin FPC connector. When S-parameters are measured, the unused ports have to be terminated with ideal 50deg resistors, which is not easy for 40 port system. Therefore, we measured signal transfer characteristics of any 2 ports with other 38 ports open, and compared them with the calculated ones from Ansoft HFSS (High Frequency Structure Simulator), which is a commercial software. The coincidence between the measured and calculated ones was excellent up to 3 GHz, which provides the validity of HFSS calculation results. Then the S-parameters are calculated using HFSS software, and equivalent circuit parameters of 40-pin FPC connector are extracted. Finally, S-parameters obtained from the equivalent circuit model showed very good coincidence to the S-parameters from the HFSS simulation.

articleTitle: The Anti-jamming Performance of GNSS BOC signals in Certain Jamming Environments
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: The binary offset carrier planned for future GNSS signals, including several GALILEO signals as well as the GPS M-code, presents a high degree of spectral separation from conventional signals and improves positioning accuracy and enhances multipath rejection greatly. This paper discusses the characteristics of GNSS BOC signals, analyzes the anti-jamming performance of various GNSS BOC signals in certain jamming environments , analyses the differences performance of various BOC signals in certain jamming environments, such as narrow interference, matching frequency spectrum interference and limited band white noise jamming.

articleTitle: A CPW-fed staircase shape antenna with dual stopband characteristic for UWB communications
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: A coplanar waveguide (CPW) -fed staircase shape antenna with dual stopband characteristic is presented in this paper. The proposed antenna consists of a CPW-rectangular feeding line and a symmetrical staircase shape radiation patch. By using a U-slot in the feeding line, a stopband of 800MHz for band rejection of wireless local area network (WLAN) is achieved. Another stopband of 600MHz is obtained by implanting two slits in the ground plane. Experimental results show the designed antenna, with a compact size of 34 mm × 25.4mm, has an impedance bandwidth of 3.01–10.67 GHz for voltage standing wave radio (VSWR) less than 2, except two frequency stopbands of 3.4–4.2 GHz and 5.1–5.9GHz. Moreover, the antenna also shows omnidirectional radiation patterns in the H-lane and good gain flatness.

articleTitle: A design of Ka-band GaAs PHEMT power amplifier MMIC
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: The design of a Ka-band power amplifier is presented. The three-stage amplifier exhibits an output power of 0.5 watt with small signal gain above 16 dB across the 32 GHz to 34 GHz band. The amplifier is characterized using linear and nonlinear methods. The stability, especially odd mode stability, is carefully considered. Both schematic and EM simulation results are shown.

articleTitle: Design of quasi-optical subsystem for millimeter-wave imaging system
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: Methods of quasi-optical subsystem is researched to improve the spatial resolution of the millimeter-wave imaging system. On the basis of characteristics comparison of different design methods, fundamental Gaussian beam method is introduced in detail and formulas are given. Relationship between waist radius and gain of feed antenna is researched. Effects of beam truncation are discussed and lens as the focusing element is designed as well. At last, the quasi-optical subsystem for millimeter-wave imaging systems is designed with fundamental Gaussian beam method. Design process is easy to carry out and all parameters are given by formulas. So the quasi-optical design is practical for millimeter-wave imaging system.

articleTitle: The effect of electromagnetic environment of high-voltage transmission line and ubstations on electronic equipment test
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: The electromagnetic environment of high voltage transmission lines and substations as well as its influence on electronic equipment test are researched. And the electromagnetic scatter caused by high voltage power lines and substations is mostly analyzed. The radiowave propagation affected by substations is tested, which is shown that the effect of vertical polarization caused by substations is much more serious than single transmission lines.

articleTitle: Improved complex model of electromagnetic scattering for two dimensional fractal sea surface
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: In this paper, we present an improved complex model of electromagnetic scattering for two dimensional fractal sea surface. Both the geometrical fractal characteristic and permittivity characteristic of sea water is roundly considered. Specially, the effect of salinity and temperature on the electromagnetic field scattered by sea water is added on. Finally, the computational results of this model are given to confirm the validity. Therefore, using this model, we can obtain the whole electromagnetic scattering characteristic of sea surface.

articleTitle: An universal method for full wave analysis of arbitrarily shaped microstrip antenna on finite ground substrate
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: A coupled surface-volume integral equation approach is presented for analysis of arbitrarily shaped microstrip antennas on finite ground substrate. The method is more universal than traditional MoM. The basis functions defined in pairs of tetrahedral volume elements (SWG) and on pairs of triangular patches (RWG) are used to represent the unknown currents in dielectric cells and on conductive patches respectively. Formulas for calculating the Z-matrix in MoM are provided in detail. In particular, the boundary condition of conductor-dielectric interface is satisfied by adding a Δ Z-matrix to Z-matrix. Numerical results of three typical microstrip antennas show the validity of the method in this paper.

articleTitle: FPGA implementation of Dsss RF front-end based on software radio
publicationTitle: 2008 8th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory
abstract: Spread spectrum technology can effectively solve the problems such as bad channel environment, multi-path fading etc between mobile station and subscribers. With the rapidly development of micro-electronic and EDA technology, now the research on base band signal treatment is more concentrated on how to implement high system performance and low bit error rate. This paper introduces a new error correction scheme which combines BCH encoding with interleaving technology, gives out a simple and efficient method to implement the error correcting code and interleaving technique of source coding, and spreading sequence generation which is suitable for the mobile communication, and designs circuit under electronic design software Quartus II using VHDL. At last the accuracy of this method was verified on FPGA.
